source_identity.description: Frozen native/controller/adapter/test source file manifest, excluding documentation; every listed file was rechecked against its SHA-256 before preparing this evidence.
source_identity.digest_definition: Sort entries lexicographically by relative path; concatenate SHA256, two spaces, relative path and newline per entry as UTF-8; SHA-256 the concatenation.

profile.presentation: focused software single-buffer 8-bit integer scale with no bands
profile.input: finite operator fixture SDL events; fresh mouse confirmation and genuine fresh Y after actual modal presentation
profile.assets: lawfully supplied local game resources, not included in publication
profile.timing_policy: watchdogs bound runtime only; no timing equality or timing fairness threshold

initial_attempt.diagnosis: TFTD rules resize native battlescape buttons, leaving the base surface redraw flag set. An inverted selected button blits its ready alternate surface; the prior nonvirtual base-only visibility proof incorrectly rejected this visible control. The resulting unavailable context failed the old generic field-shape assertion 182.
initial_attempt.correction: A control-only virtual visibility proof now checks the actual displayed alternate surface, retaining parent visibility/crop and exact geometry checks, while ignoring only the unused base redraw flag. Baseline blit/cache behavior is unchanged.
initial_attempt.regression: Actual temporary BattlescapeButton blits into a temporary native Surface, verifies readiness through Surface*, and rejects pending base redraw until it is actually drawn, hidden/cropped state and mismatched alternate geometry.

parity_cases: standing with firing and kneel reservation
adversarial_worlds: observation unavailable after dispatch, without another command

coverage.reaction_scope: Immediate actual reaction-queue parity at the end of the normal UI callback, before simulation consumes it; no completed post-reaction visible outcome is claimed.

retained_pre_success_outcomes.recovery_policy: Stopped attempts were retained. Later demonstrations were separate explicit operator restarts; failed or uncertain commands were not automatically reissued.
